thread:
yasmin.design: Noticed a keyboard + screenreader issue on the Private setup wizard network step. When CIDR shows an error the Next button gets focus before the Instance label, breaking linear flow. Also copy uses both 'Instance name' and 'Hostname' in different places.
tony.prod: Oof. Which build? Any reproducible steps?
liam.platform: Repro on Chrome/Win and Safari/macOS. Steps: 1) enter invalid CIDR, 2) tab through fields, 3) focus jumps to Next instead of Instance field. No console errors. Likely DOM order change when showing the error node.
zoe.devex: We recently moved inline errors into a sibling node that renders above the inputs — that can change focus order. Fix: render errors as part of the input block (same DOM order) and keep element ids stable so React doesn't remount.
yasmin.design: For copy: propose unified label "Instance ID (optional)" and helper: "Letters, numbers, hyphens. Shown in logs and debug UIs." Short, consistent.
tony.prod: Agreed on "Instance ID". Make the inline CIDR error compact: "Invalid CIDR — use 10.0.0.0/16" with a "More" chevron to expand examples.
liam.platform: Implementation plan: 1) keep input keyed by id, not error text, 2) move error into same container and keep tab order stable, 3) add aria-describedby to point to helper, 4) set role="status" for live validation so SRs announce it.
zoe.devex: Also add forced-colors focus ring fallback for high-contrast: `@media (forced-colors: active) { .input:focus { outline: 3px solid WindowText; } }`. I'll add to the theme patch.
yasmin.design: I uploaded a short keyboard-run GIF and updated the FigJam copy.
tony.prod: Can someone file a ticket w/ repro, screenshots, and acceptance criteria? Acceptance: no focus traps, SR reads errors, label changed, compact CIDR error + Examples panel. Mark P2.
kb-bot: Ticket INF-8901 created: "Network step tab order & Instance ID copy harmonization" — assignees liam.platform, zoe.devex, yasmin.design.
